pages.text: $(l)Optimize performance$()$(li)For an Immersive Engineering diesel line, put the torcherino on the Redstone Engineering block; IE stays very light on TPS even at x36.
$(l)Avoid wasted effort$()$(li)Shell 3 only needs 2 fluid types and 3 dimensions—don’t overcomplicate setup.$(li)Shell 4 is simple beyond bee breeding; focus on core progression first.
